**Milestone:** M5
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M5-05
**Implementation status:** Backlog (to-do); planned only, no implementation or verification claimed. Kaneo column is authoritative if later changed.

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Complete the first production-to-native vertical slice using actual action resolution evidence.

**Scope:** Pinned Korangar synthetic Walk playback, exact-slot traces, transformed regressions and separately scoped acceptance packet.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Native evidence pins executable/source identity, installed artifact hashes/path, requested Walk/view, resolved numeric ACT slot, observed frame/layer sequence and fallback status.
- [ ] Standard reachable native action views resolve exactly; ASSET_LOADED, fallback/modulo or screenshots without selection proof cannot satisfy REQUESTED_ACTION_VERIFIED.
- [ ] Complete declared checklist → supplied PNG → explicit composition approval → deterministic compile → Rust decode → native exact-Walk chain; scope/full-profile/visual/native results remain separate.
- [ ] Narrow harness-only scope may be diagnostic but cannot receive full-profile production or native-verified claims when runtime falls back.
- [ ] Record native/operator decision and any failed/unrun gates; suspected codec/slot defect requires correction before relying on output. M5 needs its own proof even if M0-N passed.

## Verification

Run pinned exact-action harness with independent inspectable traces/captures and compare installed hashes; repeat relevant multilayer regressions; environment blockers remain NATIVE_UNVERIFIED.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. No tests, approvals or native runs are claimed by this planning record.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-26 (M5-04; task ID tju1c32n1jrxitklr5hnj6la)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Reuse M0-06 evidence recipe/build selection as context, not proof for changed artifacts; no upstream modifications.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Code changes / diff: Not implemented by this planning sync.
- Test commands / exit statuses / artifact hashes: NOT_RUN (planning only).
- Milestone gates / limitations: Not evaluated; structural, coverage, visual, preview and native states remain separate.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

Not performed for implementation. Implementer supplies evidence and moves to QA Review; a distinct read-only reviewer records QA_PASS / QA_FAIL / QA_BLOCKED. Operator-only visual/native decisions remain separate. No acceptance is granted by backlog creation.",
